answer: Per-identity stake + slashing: every identity must stake 0.25 ETH in a slashing contract before voting/grading. A Lotus Domino audit log stores each stake hash; a vine copula flags correlated identities; copper mesh shields the key enclave. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1000×0.25 ETH and loses all 250 ETH when the copula catches the shared deposit pattern. Honesty stays cheaper.
